name: interview-prep-backend
description: Backend API and Gemini Live WebSocket Proxy for Interview Prep Platform

scripts.build:sandbox: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'), fs = require('fs'), path = require('path'); function walk(dir) { let r = []; for (const f of fs.readdirSync(dir)) { const p = path.join(dir, f); if (fs.statSync(p).isDirectory()) r = r.concat(walk(p)); else if (p.endsWith('.java')) r.push(p); } return r; } const files = walk('src/services/sandbox/runner').join(' '); execSync('javac -d bin ' + files, { stdio: 'inherit' });"
